svg.title: Evaluation timelines in two software buyer groups

cc:Work.dc:title: Evaluation timelines in two software buyer groups
cc:Work.dc:description: 3,500 software purchasers in nine countries. Bars use different buyer groups and different time bands; they are not complementary shares. Observational survey association cannot show that a shorter evaluation causes success. Capterra is a commercial software marketplace.
